assets.name: 01-workers
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high resolution 16:9 CONCEPT SCREENSHOT for the Minecraft Java mod AUTOMATONE. This is the first screen in a coherent UI concept set. Render only ONE large usable interface, front-facing, readable, not a collage, not a webpage, not a physical computer.
Visual direction: clean professional Minecraft-native inventory UI, crisp square pixel edges, restrained stone-gray beveled panels, charcoal inset surfaces, readable off-white pixel typography, compact moss-green active accents, iron and copper hardware details sparingly. Minimal grain, generous breathing room, aligned grid, no glassmorphism, no rounded web cards, no neon cyberpunk, no giant decorative machinery. Very subtly dimmed blocky Minecraft Overworld visible behind the central screen. Interface fills 92 percent of frame.
SCREEN: OWNED WORKERS ROSTER. Header small custom handheld controller icon, title "AUTOMATONE", subtitle "Worker controller". Top navigation tabs "Workers" (selected) and "Configuration", close X. Below: "Your workers" and counter "7 / 10", secondary button "Select workers".
CRITICAL EXACT GRID: TEN equal slots arranged in TWO ROWS OF FIVE horizontally. First row five occupied cards; second row two occupied cards, then the eighth slot Add worker card, then two quiet empty slots. NO third row. Occupied cards each contain a small Minecraft blocky humanoid worker portrait holding a pickaxe, a short unique name, dimension, coordinates, current goal and a text+icon status. Keep each card compact and legible.
First row names "Atlas", "Flint", "Ember", "Moss", "Slate". Second row names "Copper", "Echo". Atlas card: "Overworld", "128, 64, -320", "Iron ores", "Mining · 18/64". Flint: "Deepslate ores", "Idle". Ember: "Nether", "Quartz", "Mining · Unlimited". Moss: "Stone", "Complete · 64/64". Slate: "Iron ores", "Stopped". Copper: "Copper ores", "Mining · 9/32". Echo: "Diamond ores", "Needs attention". All occupied cards show coordinates and dimension in consistent positions. Green active labels, subtle gold attention badge, neutral idle labels; color never replaces words. Eighth slot prominent plus icon and "Add worker". Lower footer tiny "Click a worker to manage" and "Esc  Close". Clear visual hierarchy, beautifully crafted but practical actual-game GUI. No other pages, no marketing copy, no unrelated HUD.
